record.original_question: Which cyclic local rotations of the edges at the vertices of K_n can occur in a planar drawing of K_n?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2 Determine those rotations on Kn that can arise from a planar drawing.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A drawing of the complete graph $K_n$ in the plane is a representation in which each vertex is mapped to a distinct point of the plane and each edge is represented by a simple Jordan arc connecting its endpoints, such that no arc passes through a vertex other than its endpoints and any two arcs share only finitely many points (each shared interior point being a proper crossing). For each vertex $v$ of $K_n$, the rotation at $v$ induced by such a drawing is the cyclic order of the edges incident to $v$ obtained by reading them off in the clockwise direction in a small neighborhood of $v$. The rotation system of the drawing is the collection of these cyclic local rotations, one at each vertex.

Problem. Characterize exactly which assignments of cyclic permutations $\pi_v$ of the edges incident to $v$, taken over all vertices $v$ of $K_n$, can occur as the rotation system of some drawing of $K_n$ in the plane.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on simple drawings of $K_n$ has provided partial characterizations: a pre-rotation system is drawable as a simple drawing of $K_n$ if and only if certain small (4-, 5-, and 6-element) induced subconfigurations are drawable, and SAT-based enumeration has been used to study and characterize realizable rotation systems. A complete and concise combinatorial characterization for all $n$ remains an active research topic, so the problem is best described as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Investigating Simple Drawings of K_n using SAT
status_evidence.snippet: The rotation system of a simple drawing captures the cyclic order of edges around vertices; SAT-based methods are used to enumerate and characterize realizable rotation systems of K_n.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizing which rotation systems arise from simple drawings of K_n is an active research problem with recent partial results.

status_evidence.title: Master's Thesis: Rotation Systems and Good Drawings
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses which cyclic permutations at vertices can be realized by good drawings of complete graphs and provides partial characterizations via small forbidden subconfigurations.
status_evidence.claim: Partial characterizations of drawable rotation systems for K_n exist, but a full combinatorial characterization is not settled.
